shortDescription: According to ChainCatcher, Cosmos Hub Proposal 1061 to fix a governance query issue has entered the voting stage, surpassed the quorum threshold, and received near-unanimous support. If approved, validators will need to upgrade their nodes to Gaia v29.1.0 at block height 33,935,300.
